name: Mitten Extracts | 3g Max Infused Preroll | Strawberry Cough
description:
Sweet, ripe strawberries lead the way with subtle herbal undertones for a classic fruit-forward profile. Smooth and flavorful, this iconic strain-inspired option never goes out of style.

Mitten Extracts Infused Prerolls is where premium indoor flower meets the art of infusion. Our prerolls are meticulously crafted with top-tier flower, enhanced with live resin terpenes, liquid diamond infusion, completed with a roll in fresh kief that results in bright new flavors and unparalleled potency. Experience the cooled and refreshing smoke of our luxury ceramic tip cones for convenience and on-the-go enjoyment.
